name: Shiraishi An
source:
An is a cool and candid girl with an unyielding spirit. Her father is a former musician who's quite a big shot in the street music scene in Shibuya. She dreams of being able to put on a live show that surpasses even RAD WEEKEND, the one her father performed in.

She's part of the street music group Vivid BAD SQUAD.

[From in-game profile]
